entries.title: Job 29:1
segments: ¶And Job continued his parable and said,

entries.title: Job 29:2
segments: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when +God preserved me;

entries.title: Job 29:3
segments: When his lamp shone over my head, [and] by his light I walked through darkness;

entries.title: Job 29:4
segments: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret counsel of +God was over my tent,

entries.title: Job 29:5
segments: When the Almighty was yet with me, my young men round about me;

entries.title: Job 29:6
segments: When my steps were bathed in milk, and the rock poured out beside me rivers of oil! ...

entries.title: Job 29:7
segments: ¶When I went out to the gate by the city, when I prepared my seat on the broadway,

entries.title: Job 29:8
segments: The young men saw me, and hid themselves; and the aged arose [and] stood up;

entries.title: Job 29:9
segments: Princes refrained from talking, and laid the hand on their mouth;

entries.title: Job 29:10
segments: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue cleaved to their palate.

entries.title: Job 29:11
segments: When the ear heard [me], then it blessed me, and when the eye saw [me], it gave witness to me;

entries.title: Job 29:12
segments: For I delivered the afflicted that cried, and the fatherless who had no helper.

entries.title: Job 29:13
segments: The blessing of him that was perishing came upon me, and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

entries.title: Job 29:14
segments: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; my justice was as a mantle and a turban.

entries.title: Job 29:15
segments: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame;

entries.title: Job 29:16
segments: I was a father to the needy, and the cause which I knew not I searched out;

entries.title: Job 29:17
segments: And I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

entries.title: Job 29:18
segments: ¶And I said, I shall die in my nest, and multiply my days as the sand;

entries.title: Job 29:19
segments: My root shall be spread out to the waters, and the dew will lie all night on my branch;

entries.title: Job 29:20
segments: My glory shall be fresh in me, and my bow be renewed in my hand.

entries.title: Job 29:21
segments: Unto me they listened, and waited, and kept silence for my counsel:

entries.title: Job 29:22
segments: After my words they spoke not again, and my speech dropped upon them;

entries.title: Job 29:23
segments: And they waited for me as for the rain, and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

entries.title: Job 29:24
segments: [If] I laughed on them, they believed [it] not; and they troubled not the serenity of my countenance.

entries.title: Job 29:25
segments: I chose their way, and sat as chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth mourners.
